F1 fixtures were captured from the public Jolpica alpha API on September 5, 2026 (September 6 UTC). The schedule is the full 2026 calendar; FP1/FP2/FP3/Q and the empty R response are from Monza (round_rcsVMlOc), SQ/SR from China (round_JqmngOvt), and past-R from Zandvoort (round_OlKoikhn).

Sources: https://api.jolpi.ca/f1/alpha/schedules/2026/ and https://api.jolpi.ca/f1/alpha/results/{round_id}/{code}/ . API documentation: https://api.jolpi.ca/docs/ ; announcement: https://github.com/jolpica/jolpica-f1/discussions/319 .

These fixtures are host-test inputs only and are never embedded in the firmware. Race-day clock tests explicitly remap the historical Dutch result to a simulated Monza race; this is a lifecycle test, not a prediction. The API exposes published classifications with no session finality flag.
